
{{alias}}( [x, y,] [options] )
    Returns a line chart instance.

    Chart data may be provided as either `x` and `y` values or as `y` values
    alone, where `y` may be an array-like object, an ndarray, or an array of
    such values. Data provided as positional arguments always takes precedence
    over the `data` option.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ArrayLike|ndarray (optional)
        An array-like object or ndarray containing x-coordinate values.

    y: ArrayLike|ndarray|Array (optional)
        An array-like object, an ndarray, or an array of such values
        containing y-coordinate values.

    options: Object (optional)
        Options.

    options.colors: string|Array<string> (optional)
        Line colors. Default: category10 color scheme.

    options.legend: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether to display a chart legend. Default: false.

    options.lineOpacity: number|Array<number> (optional)
        Line opacity. Each value must be on the interval [0,1]. Default:
        [ 1.0 ].

    options.lineStyle: string|Array<string> (optional)
        Line style(s). Must be one or more of the following: '-' (solid), '--'
        (dashed), '-.' (dash-dotted), or ':' (dotted). Default: [ '-' ].

    options.lineSymbol: string|Array<string> (optional)
        Legend line symbol(s). Default: [ 'stroke' ].

    options.lineWidth: number|Array<number> (optional)
        Line width(s) in pixels. Default: [ 2 ].

    options.background: string (optional)
        Background color.

    options.channels: Object (optional)
        Object mapping chart data field names to encoding channels ('x', 'y',
        and 'z'). Default: { 'x': 'x', 'y': 'y' }.

    options.data: ArrayLike (optional)
        Chart data. Default: [].

    options.description: string (optional)
        Chart description. Default: ''.

    options.height: number (optional)
        Chart height (in pixels). Default: 480.

    options.labels: Array<string> (optional)
        Data labels. Default: [].

    options.padding: Object (optional)
        Chart padding. Default: { 'bottom': 0, 'left': 0, 'right': 0, 'top':
        0 }.

    options.theme: Object (optional)
        Chart theme.

    options.title: string|Array<string> (optional)
        Chart title. Default: ''.

    options.viewer: string (optional)
        Default chart viewer.

    options.width: number (optional)
        Chart width (in pixels). Default: 600.

    options.xFormat: string|Object (optional)
        x-axis tick format.

    options.xMax: number (optional)
        Maximum value of the x-axis domain.

    options.xMin: number (optional)
        Minimum value of the x-axis domain.

    options.xScaleType: string (optional)
        x-axis scale type. Default: 'linear'.

    options.xTickCount: number|string|Object (optional)
        Number of x-axis tick marks.

    options.xTitle: string|Array<string> (optional)
        x-axis label. Default: 'x'.

    options.yFormat: string|Object (optional)
        y-axis tick format.

    options.yMax: number (optional)
        Maximum value of the y-axis domain.

    options.yMin: number (optional)
        Minimum value of the y-axis domain.

    options.yScaleType: string (optional)
        y-axis scale type. Default: 'linear'.

    options.yTickCount: number|string|Object (optional)
        Number of y-axis tick marks.

    options.yTitle: string|Array<string> (optional)
        y-axis label. Default: 'y'.

    Returns
    -------
    chart: LineChart
        Line chart instance.

    chart.colors
        Line colors.

    chart.colorScale
        Ordinal scale mapping datasets to line colors (read-only).

    chart.legend
        Boolean indicating whether to display a chart legend.

    chart.lineOpacity
        Line opacity.

    chart.lineOpacityScale
        Ordinal scale mapping datasets to line opacities (read-only).

    chart.lineStyle
        Line style(s).

    chart.lineStyleScale
        Ordinal scale mapping datasets to line styles (read-only).

    chart.lineSymbol
        Legend line symbol(s).

    chart.lineSymbolScale
        Ordinal scale mapping datasets to legend line symbols (read-only).

    chart.lineWidth
        Line width(s) in pixels.

    chart.lineWidthScale
        Ordinal scale mapping datasets to line widths (read-only).

    chart.render( clbk )
        Renders a chart as an SVG string. The callback is invoked with an
        error argument (null upon success) and the rendered SVG string.

    chart.toJSON()
        Serializes a chart as a JSON object (i.e., a Vega specification).

    Examples
    --------
    > var chart = new {{alias}}( [ 1, 2, 3 ], [ 4, 5, 6 ] )
    <LineChart>
    > chart.lineStyle = '--';
    > chart.lineStyle
    [ '--' ]
    > chart.legend = true;
    > chart.legend
    true

    See Also
    --------
